sbd_devices.description: List of block devices or loopback files used by SBD for message passing and disk locking. Must be shared across all cluster nodes. Use colon-separated format in rendered config (e.g., '/dev/sdb:/dev/sdc').

items.description: Path to a shared SBD device (e.g., /dev/disk/by-id/scsi-...)

sbd_daemon_enabled.description: Enable the SBD daemon to run on this node (required for local fencing). Set to false only if using external SBD (rare).

sbd_timeout.description: Time in seconds the node waits for a response from other nodes before initiating STONITH. Must be ≥ 1 and ≥ 2 × SBDWatchdogTimeout.

sbd_watchdog_timeout.description: Time in seconds between watchdog pings. Must be less than half of SBDTimeout to allow time for recovery attempts.

sbd_num_messages.description: Number of consecutive missed messages allowed before the node is considered dead and fenced.

sbd_start_delay.description: Seconds to delay SBD daemon start after boot (useful if storage devices take time to appear).

sbd_debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to system logs. Set to true only for troubleshooting.

sbd_extra_options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to fence_sbd (e.g., '-z' for zero-length mode or '-p' for partitioned mode). Leave empty unless required.
